import asyncio, json, sys, os, stat
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts")
from safe_runtime import _connected_client
from telethon_sessions import DEFAULT_VAULT, inspect
marker=Path("/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/self-notification-test-20261031.json")
config=inspect(DEFAULT_VAULT)
if marker.is_symlink(): raise SystemExit("MARKER_SYMLINK_BLOCKED")
if marker.exists():
 print("SELF_NOTIFICATION_TEST_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED_NO_REPLAY",marker.stat().st_size)
 raise SystemExit(0)
fd=os.open(marker,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"w") as w:
 json.dump({"attempted":[1,2],"purpose":"voluntary_approval_notification_transport_test"},w)
 w.flush();os.fsync(w.fileno())
async def check(number):
 client=await _connected_client(config,number)
 try:
  message=f"TESTE — Telegram Robot Leads, conta {number}. Verificação da entrega de notificações. Não foi adicionado nenhum membro."
  result=await asyncio.wait_for(client.send_message("me",message,link_preview=False),timeout=27)
  sent_id=getattr(result,"id",None)
  if type(sent_id) is not int or sent_id<=0:
   return {"account":number,"send_status":"UNCERTAIN","received":False}
  check=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_messages("me",ids=sent_id),timeout=20)
  matched=getattr(check,"message",None)==message
  return {"account":number,"send_status":"ACCEPTED","readback":matched,"id_positive":True}
 finally:
  if client.is_connected():
   await client.disconnect()
async def main():
 for number in (1,2):
  try: print("OWN_SAVED_MESSAGES",json.dumps(await check(number),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
  except Exception as exc: print("OWN_SAVED_MESSAGES",json.dumps({"account":number,"status":"ERROR","class":type(exc).__name__}),flush=True)
asyncio.run(main())
print("NO_EXTERNAL_RECIPIENTS_USED")
